task: Convert a text-based PDF to Markdown and keep its tables
packaging_note: Runs the CPU PDF pipeline with pinned Heron layout and accurate TableFormer weights. Builds the tagged release from its checksum-pinned PyPI source distribution.

inputs.what: a PDF with selectable text, optionally including tables

outputs.what: the PDF's text and tables in Markdown

known_issues: Image-only scans need OCR first. Complex layouts may still need manual correction.
licence: Docling MIT; Heron Apache-2.0; Docling Models lists CDLA-Permissive-2.0 and Apache-2.0. The image includes the model cards and licence notices.

x-display.title: Convert PDFs to Markdown
x-display.summary: Extract a PDF’s selectable text and tables into a Markdown file.
x-display.description: Bring reports and other PDF documents into a text editor, notes collection or a tool that reads Markdown. You can work with the extracted content without carrying over the PDF’s fixed page layout. This recipe packages the text-based PDF conversion path.
